label: Reading the center
subgoals: Match each squared term to x minus h
Handle a plus sign inside the square

visual.title: The signs inside the squares flip
visual.caption: In (x − h)²/a² + (y − k)²/b² = 1 the centre is (h, k), not (−h, −k). The figure shows (x − 2)²/4 + (y + 1)² = 1, whose centre is (2, −1). A plus sign inside a square means a negative coordinate.

predict.question: What is the centre of (x − 2)²/4 + (y + 1)² = 1?
predict.explain: Read each square as x − h and y − k. Here h = 2 and k = −1, so the centre is (2, −1). The plus sign in y + 1 gives the negative y-coordinate.
